copilot.intro: Ask about {region}: top issues, funding history, forecasts, or what data exists.
copilot.scopeNote: Scoped to your jurisdiction and role ({role}). Requests outside it are refused at the tool layer.
copilot.starter4: Are there any forecast risks here?
equity.how.body: Issues are grouped by the vulnerability of their area (low, medium, high). For each group we compare average priority score, the share that reached funding, and time to resolution. A large gap would mean the process is treating vulnerable areas differently.
equity.how.title: How this works
equity.minSample: A band needs at least 5 scored issues before we publish its numbers.
equity.pickState: Choose a state in the jurisdiction selector to run the audit.
equity.verdictNote: Generated from the same numbers shown below. Nothing is invented.
footer.about: JanSetu turns what citizens say into ranked, explainable priorities for public investment, in their own language.
footer.legal: JanSetu is a prototype built for the Google Cloud 'Build with AI: Code for Communities' hackathon. Sample data is labelled as such.
footer.p3: Built as a Digital Public Good
forecast.none.body: A forecast appears when a problem has recurred in the same season across years with no investment since.
forecast.notReport.body: It never feeds a priority score. It is an early signal for officers only.
forecast.notReport.title: A forecast is not a citizen report
forecast.skipped.sub: Why the other categories were left out. We do not guess with thin history.
forecast.skipped.title: Not forecast
guard.forbiddenBody: Your role does not include this capability. Ask a state administrator if you need it.
guard.forbiddenTitle: You do not have access to this page
insights.forbidden: You don't have access to this view.
issue.emergency.body: Emergency override bypasses the minimum-reporter threshold so this issue is scored at the next cycle. It is recorded in the audit log.
issue.history.none: No actions recorded for this issue yet.
issue.impact.body: {got} of {need} confirmations received, {no} said not fixed.
issue.impact.title: Citizen confirmation
issue.justification.hint: At least a few words. Be specific.
issue.notScored: This issue has not been scored yet. It needs 3 distinct reporters, or an emergency override.
issue.project.needsScore: Available once the issue has been scored.
issue.project.none: No project yet for this issue.
landing.aud.citizen.body: Report in your language, follow your report to a fix, and confirm it was done.
landing.aud.citizen.title: Citizens
landing.aud.officer.body: A ranked, explainable worklist with a map, projects, forecasts and a co-pilot, scoped to your jurisdiction.
landing.aud.officer.title: District and state officers
landing.aud.public.body: An open ledger of how many issues are reported, funded and fixed. No login, no personal data.
landing.aud.public.title: The public
landing.aud.title: Built for three audiences
landing.badge: Powered by Gemini, built as a Digital Public Good
landing.f.copilot.body: Ask questions in plain language. Answers are grounded in real data or refused.
landing.f.copilot.title: Policy co-pilot
landing.f.dedup.body: Reports about the same problem merge across languages, so demand is counted honestly.
landing.f.dedup.title: One issue, not ten
landing.f.equity.body: A built-in check that asks whether vulnerable areas are actually treated fairly.
landing.f.equity.title: Fairness audit
landing.f.forecast.body: Recurring seasonal problems are flagged before the reports arrive.
landing.f.forecast.title: Early warning
landing.f.languages.body: Hindi, Tamil, English and Portuguese, with more a translation file away.
landing.f.languages.title: Multilingual
landing.f.privacy.body: Phone numbers are hashed, personal details scrubbed, and citizens can export or erase their data.
landing.f.privacy.title: Privacy by design
landing.f.vision.body: Gemini reads photos to add context and flags images that do not show a real problem.
landing.f.vision.title: Photo intelligence
landing.f.voice.body: Speak your report. Gemini transcribes it, and replies can be read back aloud.
landing.f.voice.title: Voice first
landing.features.title: Everything a public-sector pilot needs
landing.gap1.body: The same pothole is reported ten ways, in five languages, through five channels.
landing.gap1.title: Fragmented
landing.gap2.body: Budgets follow habit, not evidence of need, vulnerability or past funding.
landing.gap2.title: Misaligned
landing.gap3.body: There is rarely proof that a fix happened, or that citizens felt it.
landing.gap3.title: Unmeasured
landing.how.title: From a citizen's words to a funded, verified fix
landing.liveEmpty: Numbers appear once enough reports have been received.
landing.problem.body: Development requests sit in fragmented systems. Spending drifts away from real need, gaps go unaddressed, and nobody can measure whether a large investment actually helped.
landing.problem.title: Citizen feedback and public spending never meet.
landing.scale.body: Adding a state or a country is configuration, not a rewrite. Brazil already runs on the same code as proof.
landing.scale.title: Built for India, ready to travel
landing.score.body: Every score shows its inputs, weights and any data it had to substitute. No black box: a policymaker, a journalist or a citizen can see exactly why a ward ranks where it does.
landing.score.title: A priority score nobody has to take on trust
landing.step1.body: Citizens report by voice, text or photo, in their own language, even with a poor connection.
landing.step1.title: Speak, type or snap
landing.step2.body: Gemini reads the report, classifies it, checks the photo and merges duplicates across languages.
landing.step2.title: AI understands and merges
landing.step3.body: Demand, vulnerability and infrastructure gap combine into a score officials can inspect and challenge.
landing.step3.title: Scored in the open
landing.step4.body: Projects are tracked to completion, and the citizens who asked confirm the fix actually happened.
landing.step4.title: Fixed and confirmed
landing.subtitle: Report a problem by voice, text or photo in your own language. JanSetu understands it, merges duplicates, scores it transparently and shows officials exactly where to invest first.
landing.title2: matched to every rupee of public investment.
